[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]10 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast (6.5) |cash = {{Money|24}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Cool Ducky''' was the second enemy to appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has an medium health with fast speed. ==Logbook Description== "''Cool Ducky is "The Man" — the main character. Every duck loves him and every duck aspires to be him. The sheer level of coolness that Cool Ducky possesses was thought to be impossible. His presence turns heads, and a singular quack can make any hen swoon. He once kick-flipped over a Ducky Unit on the first try. Now that’s cool.''" ==Appearance== The '''Cool Ducky''' is a normal, yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak. It has a black, white and orange cap, as well as black and white shoes. It rides on a black and orange skateboard with yellow wheels. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Cool Ducky''' itself is quite weak, though it generally spawns in high numbers. **Area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]] are effective at clearing them out. **Crowd control towers such as the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to stall the '''Cool Ducky''', as it moves at a fast speed. **Single target DPS towers can also be useful here. Such towers include the [[Cowboy]], [[Engineer]] or [[Ace Pilot]]. *Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] can deal with it quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CoolDuckyWalkAnimation.gif|Riding animation (16 April 2025 – Present) CoolDuckDeath.gif|Death animation (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1CoolDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCoolDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cool Ducky''' on a promotional video. The Takeover Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cool Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Ducky Revenge Intro - Tower Defense Simulator Easter 2025 Event|'''Cool Ducky''' in the opening [[Bathroom Approach]] cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Stickers}} Coolduckyt.png|'''Cool Ducky''' on the [[Cool Ducky (Sticker)|Cool Ducky]] sticker. {{GalleryHeader|Charms}} CoolDuckCharm.png|'''Cool Ducky''' on the [[Cool Duck Charm|Cool Duck]] charm. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CoolDuckyIconIG.png|'''Cool Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Cool Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Cool Ducky''' clips into the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''28 May 2025''' - [[v1.65.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' re-added to the main game, now appears in [[Bathroom Approach]]. **Health increased from 10 to 12 in Hard difficulty. **Speed increased from 6 to 6.5. **Cash given increased from {{Money|10}} to {{Money|24}} on death in Easy difficulty. **Cash given increased from {{Money|20}} to {{Money|24}} on death in Hard difficulty. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer clips into the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BathroomApproach|[[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]]|Wave 1|Cool Ducky|Wave 2|[[Eggroll 1]], [[Eggroll 2]] & [[Eggroll 3]]|Wave 4}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Cool Ducky}}
